notablePrerequisites: Aettir and Priwen attached to a creature you control that has lifelink, doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage using the creature with Aettir and Priwen attached, doubling your life total due to its lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.
